notes.title: Patch notes for v2.0.3
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 「Seeking The Guardian」 team.

[h3][b]Patch notes for v2.0.3[/b][/h3]

- Fixed unintended behavior when changing the resolution while the game is maximized or in full-screen mode. Resolution changes are now only available in windowed mode.

- Added a failsafe to allow players to regain missed achievements. However, this fix cannot restore achievements missed before this patch. Returning to the main menu will retry unlocking the achievements. If the game still fails to grant them, please check your Steam client connection.

- Fixed an issue where touchpads and certain other input devices were incorrectly detected as joypads.

Thank you for enjoying 「Seeking The Guardian」.
